knight: Kneeling on one knee behind his shield at a breached castle gate, sword braced diagonally, protecting a small lantern from drifting embers at dawn.
archer: Balanced sideways on a rain slick watchtower beam, drawing her tall yumi bow toward a distant battlefield under a red autumn moon.
samurai: In a low iaijutsu drawing stance at a misty torii gate, katana sliding from its scabbard as red maple leaves whirl.

wizard: Leaning into a sweeping staff cast in a ruined library, a spiral of controlled flame rising around levitating scorched books.
paladin: Stepping forward with shield raised and mace lowered through a broken cathedral doorway, golden morning light striking the sun emblem.
cleric: Kneeling beside a wounded traveller's discarded shield in a field hospital, prayer book open on a crate, one hand extended with gentle teal healing light.
minotaur: Planting his axe into the cracked ground as he braces at the entrance to a labyrinth, dust falling from ancient bronze doors behind him.
peasant: Bracing a long spear diagonally across a narrow rice terrace bridge at sunrise, straw hat tilted into the wind, determined defender's stance.
ninjaMonk: Balancing on one leg atop a mountain monastery post, hands held in a martial arts palm stance, prayer beads lifted by a gust of snow.
